<distribution-code display="yes">II</distribution-code><congress>119th CONGRESS</congress><session>2d Session</session><legis-num>S. 3909</legis-num><current-chamber>IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES</current-chamber><action><action-date date="20260225">February 25, 2026</action-date><action-desc><sponsor name-id="S417">Mr. Budd</sponsor> (for himself, <cosponsor name-id="S293">Mr. Graham</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="S396">Mrs. Blackburn</cosponsor>, <cosponsor name-id="S287">Mr. Cornyn</cosponsor>, and <cosponsor name-id="S419">Mr. Mullin</cosponsor>) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the <committee-name committee-id="SSJU00">Committee on the Judiciary</committee-name></action-desc></action><legis-type>A BILL</legis-type><official-title>To amend title 18, United States Code, to provide that the prohibition on the possession of firearms and ammunition by certain aliens shall apply with respect to the use of firearms and ammunition by government entities.</official-title></form><legis-body><section id="id69cdf3e8d3c64fc0980ddb7bf1444043" section-type="section-one"><enum>1.</enum><header>Short title</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Stop Illegal Alien Cops Act</short-title></quote>.</text></section><section id="S1"><enum>2.</enum><header>Use of firearms and ammunition by government entities</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">Section 925(a)(1) of title 18, United States Code, is amended by striking <quote>sections 922(d)(9) and 922(g)(9)</quote> and inserting <quote>subsections (d)(5), (d)(9), (g)(5), and (g)(9) of section 922</quote>.</text></section></legis-body></bill>
